title: Wizz Air’s NEW 12-Leg Journey + Extreme Realism? (MSFS 2024 Marketplace)
description:
Are these the best new activities in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? Today we are deep-diving into the latest Marketplace releases from Perfect Flight, including the highly debated 12-Leg Wizz Air Spring 2026 tour and the Advanced Challenges: Canada.

We explore the new A321LR missions spanning from the Baltic Coast to Sicily, featuring professional briefings and realistic IFR route logic. But it’s not just a standard flight—this pack introduces "Extreme Realism" events where you have to manage your aircraft carefully or things will go wrong. We also put our stick-and-rudder skills to the test in the Canadian wilderness with 20 high-stress landing challenges across major cities and remote bush strips.

Whether you're a low-cost carrier fan or a bush pilot looking for a challenge, there’s a lot to cover in this week's update!

Which one are you flying first? The Wizz Air tour or the Canadian challenges? Let me know in the comments!
